native_regression.boundary: Independently authored tiny native DSOs call the actual helper. Their own native callback ABI is only a fixture contract, not an assertion about the SDK function signature. positive_cases: Preparation binds an exact exported object to live writable host storage without installing or calling a callback
The tiny SDK normally writes its own callback address through the alias, invokes its own callback and rebinds it; unrelated data stays unchanged
Separate global/weak definitions share one slot, and an undefined import is skipped while its real provider is bound
negative_cases: Missing or near-match name, unsupported binding/type/size/defined metadata, duplicate definitions and repeated preparation
Read-only/out-of-bounds/unaligned/overflow storage and invalid module ranges, null base, symbols, names or arguments
Preexisting alias or callback-slot values are never overwritten
An invalid second provider causes no partial write to an already validated first provider
